title: The Three-Body Problem as required reading in disclosure discussions

tellings.quote: As Pippa relayed to me, a lot of these high-level disclosure discussions revolved around one particular book, a Chinese science fiction novel called The Threebody Problem, which became mandatory reading among many highlevel national security advisers in the United States.
During the Bush administration, key players in the federal government were urged to read the Chinese science fiction novel, The Threebody Problem,
tellings.difference: Places it specifically during the Bush administration.
tellings.link_reason: Same story: The Three-Body Problem became required reading for senior US national security officials, as relayed from Pippa Malmgren.

as_told.title: Bush administration officials urged to read The Three-Body Problem

plain: Many high-level discussions in Washington about revealing what the government knows about UFOs are said to have centred on The Three-Body Problem, a Chinese science fiction novel by Liu Cixin, which became required reading for many senior US national security advisers. Michels tells this as what he heard from Pippa Malmgren, the daughter of a former presidential adviser named Harald Malmgren. In a later episode he places it during the Bush administration. If true, it would mean a novel shaped how officials thought about the subject.
